content: Shakti Fibre Disc for Wood Sanding Applications Good Shakti fiber disc for carpenters and craftsmen Shakti Fibre Disc is a preferred choice for carpenters & craftsmen for premium finish on all types of wood. With its extra-flexible paper backing & Aluminium Oxide grains, it excels at better material removal and effortlessly achieves a smooth finish specifically for sanding curves and contours. Its extra-flexible fibre backing allows it to bend smoothly with the wood’s contour, making it ideal for furniture edges, curved legs, moldings, and decorative cut-outs. Powered with sharp aluminum oxide grains, the disc provides fast cutting action and superior sanding control, reducing operator fatigue and minimizing swirl marks before final finishing coats. Designed for dry sanding, it performs best when mounted on an angle grinder backing pad, delivering professional results in less time.
